page.overview:
Who is Amazoness Blowpiper?

Amazoness Blowpiper is a character version of the card "Amazoness Blowpiper". She appears briefly in a flashback as Tania explains how she and other denizens of her dimension unexpectedly switched dimensions in the Duel Monsters Spirit World.
